items.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: And I interviewed Louis Hayes, who was Cannonball’s drummer.

ctx.x: Spoken to him once, saw the band in its heyday, they were in Britain about 60, 61, you know with Nat. And I interviewed Louis Hayes, who was Cannonball’s drummer. And

my great pal came with me to photograph him and we published the story. Louis Hayes was a young man then. We published the story and we published a photograph which was Louis Hayes in his pajamas. Fair enough? He hadn’t got up.
